series.title: Flow Power breaks ground on 223MWh Bennetts Creek BESS in Victoria, Australia
series.summary: Flow Power has broken ground on its 100MW/223MWh Bennetts Creek BESS in Victoria, its first large-scale standalone BESS project.

series.title: 554MW of battery storage enters AEMO’s Market Management System in Australia
series.summary: The Tailem Bend BESS 3 in South Australia and Wooreen BESS in Victoria have both entered the AEMO Market Management System (MMS).

series.title: Already-operating battery storage projects are key to making the business case for the next assets bankable
series.summary: Existing assets can provide crucial benchmarks in sizing and other crucial battery storage design decisions, writes Ashutosh Vats, head of BESS business development at 3E.

series.title: Poland market shifting to ‘selective, capital-disciplined phase where execution quality matters’
series.summary: Poland's grid-scale storage market has reached an impressive scale in the last few years, helped by the capacity market and various government schemes, but numerous challenges now need to be overcome.

series.title: US energy storage industry targets 225GW/1TWh deployment by end of 2032, according to Energy Storage Coalition
series.summary: The US energy storage industry is targeting 225GW/1TWh of storage deployment by the end of 2032, according to an analysis published by the Energy Storage Coalition (ESC).

series.title: Google-backed pilot demonstrates hourly carbon accounting for US BESS using granular certificates
series.summary: A US battery storage pilot sponsored by tech giant Google has demonstrated how batteries can capture surplus renewable energy and deliver it during hours with greater fossil generation.

series.title: Federal judge restores $7B Solar for All program, says EPA illegally axed it
series.summary: A Trump-appointed judge said the One Big Beautiful Bill Act did not convert the funding into “a lump-sum amount subject to EPA’s discretion.” Defendants acted contrary to Congress’ intent and with “no other statutory authority.”

series.title: Texas PUC adopts softened rules on data center interconnection
series.summary: The Public Utility Commission of Texas backed off the standards it proposed in March, eliminating a non-refundable interconnection fee and extending energization milestone deadlines.

series.title: Lightsource bp refers 800MWh hybrid BESS project to Australia’s EPBC Act
series.summary: Lightsource bp has referred a hybrid wind, solar and BESS facility to the federal government for assessment under the EPBC Act.

series.title: Covenergo and Delta Capacity begin construction on 300MWh AKKU One BESS in Finland
series.summary: Covenergo and Delta Capacity have begun construction on AKKU One, a standalone 125MW/300MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) in Lapinlahti, Finland, with commissioning targeted for the fourth quarter of 2027.

series.title: UK: NESO looks to tackle BESS repetitive re-trading
series.summary: What is repetitive re-trading (RTT) by BESS in the UK, and what is NESO looking to do about it?

series.title: Nova Scotia Power switches on Atlantic Canada’s biggest battery storage projects
series.summary: Nova Scotia Power has inaugurated three 50MW/200MWh battery energy storage systems (BESS) in Bridgewater, Waverley and White Rock, now Atlantic Canada's largest battery storage facilities.

series.title: RWE and Giga Storage move to construction on gigawatt-hour Netherlands and Belgium batteries
series.summary: RWE has taken a final investment decision (FID) on 400MW/1.1GWh BESS in the Netherlands with construction to start in due course, while Giga Storage has started building its 2.8GWh Green Turtle project in Belgium.

series.title: PG&E selects six new California microgrids for US$30 million investment, Massachusetts awards US$40 million across 36 BESS projects
series.summary: Utility PG&E has selected six new California microgrid projects for a US$30 million investment, while Massachusetts’ Department of Energy Resources is awarding US$40 million across 36 BESS projects.

series.title: Sunrun and Tesla deliver record 580MW to California grid amid heatwave
series.summary: Residential battery energy storage systems (BESS) across California discharged more than 580MW of peak power to the state's grid on the evening of 9 September 2026 via a Tesla-Sunrun VPP.

series.title: 21GWh BESS deployed globally in August: One-fifth in Saudi Arabia, European activity soars
series.summary: Nearly 21GWh of grid-scale BESS came online globally last month, of which around a fifth was in Saudi Arabia while the majority was in China.

series.title: Other New England states back Maine’s RTO adder complaint
series.summary: The complaint at the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission is part of a trend of states seeking to end an extra 0.5% return utilities can earn for voluntarily joining a transmission organization.

series.title: California tightens oversight of data center energy use, grid costs
series.summary: Bills signed by Gov. Gavin Newsom include regulations aimed at ensuring data centers pay for infrastructure needed to serve them and bear a larger share of wildfire mitigation and liability costs.

series.title: Lower energy costs, community benefits drive 30% battery growth rate: RMI
series.summary: The report arrives as the energy storage industry faces headwinds from tariffs, Treasury regulations and new White House restrictions on foreign-made bulk electrical components.

series.title: Australia’s Victoria requires new data centres to bring their own renewable energy and storage
series.summary: Australia's Victoria mandates new data centres match demand with own renewable energy and battery storage under new rules.

series.title: ACEN relinquishes Philippine solar projects over land, access issues
series.summary: Land acquisition and site-access problems have led Philippine renewables developer ACEN to abandon two early-stage solar projects with a combined potential capacity of about 456 MW. The post ACEN relinquishes Philippine solar projects over land, access issues appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: CATL to supply 918MWh Romania BESS, another 500MWh of projects progress elsewhere in CEE
series.summary: A flurry of project completions, financings and supplier deals for large-scale BESS across the Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) region, from Greenvolt, Renovatio & CATL, Eurowind, Renalfa, MOL Group, Tavion, MetaWealth and Enexus & Longi.

series.title: Compressed air energy storage (CAES): yet to deliver on promises, can A-CAES go one step further?
series.summary: Compressed air energy storage (CAES) holds much promise for large-scale, LDES, but has struggled to get off the ground outside of China.

series.title: UK regulator looks to cut down BESS interconnection backlog with extra financial commitment
series.summary: UK energy industry regulator Ofgem said it is minded to approve the introduction of a financial commitment for BESS in an attempt to reduce the oversupply of the projects awaiting a grid connection.

series.title: GridStor closes US$220 million financing for 400MWh Arizona BESS
series.summary: GridStor, a US-based developer and operator of grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) has closed a US$220 million financing agreement for the 100MW/400MWh White Tank project in Arizona, US.

series.title: Ukraine adds 1.1 GW of solar in H1
series.summary: Analysis from the Solar Energy Association of Ukraine estimates the country's solar capacity reached up to 9.7 GW by mid-2026. The post Ukraine adds 1.1 GW of solar in H1 appeared first on pv magazine Global .

series.title: Amazon, Nadara switch on 277 MW agrivoltaic facility in Italy
series.summary: Nadara has completed the 227 MW Big Fish agrivoltaic project in Sicily, backed by a 156 MW PPA with Amazon and described by the developer as Italy’s largest agrivoltaic facility. series.title: FERC rejects ComEd’s cancellation of PowerHouse Hillwood data center contract
series.summary: A 1.8-GW, $20-billion data center planned by PowerHouse Hillwood was underpinned by a $1 letter of credit — “less than the price of a cup of coffee” — that drew skepticism from FERC Commissioner David LaCerte.

series.title: FERC has options for modernizing PJM’s governance
series.summary: The commission’s jurisdiction over transmission governance allows it to modify filing-rights allocations and adjust PJM Interconnection’s nominating committee, writes Harvard Law’s Ari Peskoe.

series.title: Poland offers 76 TWh in November renewables auctions
series.summary: Poland's Energy Regulatory Office (URE) has put almost PLN 25 billion ($6.5 billion) of renewables support up for bid in November, with PV and onshore wind taking most of it. The post Poland offers 76 TWh in November renewables auctions appeared first on pv magazine Global .
